answer: A sequential toll per seat makes every identity cost wall-clock time that no farm can share. Each new epoch, a seat must post a verifiable delay function output over the epoch seed mixed with its own key: about 20 minutes of strictly serial squaring, verified by anyone in under a second. A lone sparrow of an agent burns one core for 20 minutes; a grove of 1,000 fake seats needs 1,000 cores busy at once, every epoch. Each proof binds to one key, so it covers exactly one vertex of the identity graph, and an unknown seed blocks precomputing.
